proposedInvocation.command: env SEMBLANCE_RUN_LIMIT=115 GOMAXPROCS=2 GOMEMLIMIT=1536MiB GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off ARM_TUI_DIRECT_FIXTURE_DIR="$NEW_ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_OUTPUT" "$SHARED_FIFO" go test -p 1 -count=1 -run '^TestUXTerminalDirectFixture$' -timeout=75s ./internal/tui

variables.NEW_ABSOLUTE_PRIVATE_OUTPUT: A reviewed, fresh, resolved, absolute output directory outside the source checkout; test creates it0700 and refuses reuse.
variables.SHARED_FIFO: The already configured unchanged shared FIFO; no slots/worker/capacity override.

proposedInvocation.networkAndToolchain: GOTOOLCHAIN=local/GOPROXY=off/GOSUMDB=off prevents automatic toolchain/module download; missing local prerequisites must be reported, not installed. No backend/browser/PTy is included.
proposedInvocation.limits: Proposed115s total original command including compilation/collection/cleanup, Go test75s after startup, CPU2/memory target1536MiB, compile parallelism1. These are a proposal and cooperative targets, not a granted lease/hard enforcement or proof compilation fits.
proposedInvocation.onFailure: Preserve original exit/log/source/partial output; do not rerun or replace without reporting centrally.

plannedBounds.scope: All bounds are checked by prepared source but unexecuted. Temporary resize uses another of the same three reviewed grids, never a fourth grid.

scriptedTransitions: Actual original row OnMouse then typed dashboardMouseMsg through Update opens exact synthetic inspect/run
Original record key traversal expands request/resources and selects memory_bytes=9007199254740993 as an underlying typed exact value; no full glyph proof
Release review is created by original x path and declined through original n region; y/confirm is refused
Original bounded filter paste/apply; focus/cursor Cmd, if returned, is suppressed and counted
Captured native callback becomes stale across another reviewed grid before typed delivery; original Update must reject it
Original runs/run_output closures drain bounded pages synchronously, preserving exact byte cursor; no generic Cmd/Batch execution
Pause/start/next/follow/scroll/fold/fullscreen and exit restoration retain same original reader/buffer/offset

A genuine original read receipt is computed synchronously, held in memory, then delivered after navigation/retirement; it must not resurrect selection. This is not an in-flight blocking read/cancellation proof
Disconnected state is an explicit cached-model seed; no stream/disconnect/reconnect command or native-session behavior is exercised

effectRoster.constructor: Original newDashboard reads preferences and creates/syncs pending directory and empty lock under the fresh synthetic home. This is local filesystem mutation, explicitly disclosed; source does not call production Init.
effectRoster.transport: Only inspect/runs/run_output, exact owned IDs/cursors and expected typed argument/result shapes. Every result is cloned into typed Go structures with no untyped float64 number conversion. No native client object, endpoint/token lookup, fallback, subscription, agent/message/job/resource command. Stream interface methods refuse/count if reached.
approvedClosureCallsites: directFixture.command: invokes only closures returned by audited original loadDetail/readRunPage/key paths and original same-reader acceptRunsRead continuation, with result type/owner/budget checks
directFixture.mouse: invokes only original View.OnMouse closure returning dashboardMouseMsg, then original Update with state-aware effect policy
runDirectGeometry stale callback: original OnMouse typed event closure only
runDirectGeometry held receipt: original readRuns(true) closure only, synchronous result retained then delivered after retire
effectRoster.commandGate: Closed input/message set; no tick/stream/connected/reconnect or mutation receipts. State-aware keys and current mouse regions are validated before Update; no roster h, Name/Recovery/check-in/message/pool/mesh, confirmation, native-session or arbitrary input. Non-read return must be nil or explicitly suppressed unexecuted library Cmd. Never invoke tea.Batch/opaque children/timers/cursor/viewport Cmds.
effectRoster.libraryCommands: Input focus/paste and viewport key return commands are recorded by source origin and left uninvoked. Their runtime absence does not qualify a native event loop, blink/focus behavior or timer cleanup. No claim their implementation was exhaustively audited.
effectRoster.directFrameEffects: Private output directory, exact View.Content frame files, JSON metadata and constructor home bookkeeping only. Generated frames are not written to a terminal and do not activate terminal-control sequences.
effectRoster.forbidden: Any unknown operation/message/key/region/shape/owner or changed source stops and preserves failure. A strict fake backend does not itself authorize arbitrary Cmd; source has separate command/local-effect gates.

plannedOutputs.rawFrames: Up to48 named .view.ansi files containing unmodified original View.Content; private0600 files under output0700. AltScreen flag is metadata only, not actual alternate-buffer/PTY output.
plannedOutputs.report: direct-fixture.json with source/data/frame hashes, original view sizes and ANSI cell counts, typed regions, selected IDs/default/filter/feed/viewport state, exact record node, reader buffer/cursor/generation/fold/follow metadata, audited calls and suppressed commands.
plannedOutputs.privacy: Static synthetic IDs/names/paths/commands and inert controls only; no real ARM state, credentials, local host/user/session/agent/contact data. Runtime output stays outside version control and requires normalization before publication.
plannedOutputs.notProduced: No browser raster, emulator screen, real tty transcript, installed binary, live session or application mutation.
